assumptions: P04 is a new implementation slice: all three required files are absent, and the recovery record contains no prior P04 attempt or review findings. This planning pass changes no files.

Use existing Python, fractions.Fraction and Z3; record their actual versions. Exact rationals and bounded solver scope come from core-contract.md. Z3 is available, but its answers require independent checks; it is an implementation choice, not a promoted numerical default.

Support explicit, caller-supplied template registries, finite slot declarations, context-compatible observations and rational-linear state/report mappings. Automated disclosure interpretation, arbitrary template discovery and full accounting execution remain outside this slice.

P03's Core0.1 validator deliberately requires unsearched history families and rejects finite choices. Consume validated P03 inputs through a new adapter and return a separate versioned reconstruction result; preserve the accepted compiler, schema and evidence.

Every request must explicitly declare integer bounds, rounding convention/stage, evidence view, query scope and resource limits. Unknown conventions remain unresolved. Small fixture sizes and budgets are engineering test choices, not production defaults.
Implementation requires an authorised writable execution environment. This planner is read-only; no approval or sandbox bypass is requested.
checks: Run python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_accounting_p04.py' -v. Require every catalogued obligation to execute, with no failures, errors, skips, duplicate IDs or missing observations.

Compare complete feasible assignment sets for small bounded integer/finite-choice models against an independently written Fraction-based enumerator that replays original templates and observations without calling production lowering or Z3. Check retained known histories and rejected incompatible histories.

Exercise renamed identifiers, reordered declarations and changes to openings, observations, rates, incidence coefficients and slot limits. Outputs must follow inputs; expected answers and legacy hand-entered constraint strings must never enter production construction.

Check the rounded debt case against independent algebra: interest infimum 199/40 is attained; supremum 1407/200 is unattained. Include negative rounding ties, half-even parity, exact posting quantisation, bounded integer gaps, infeasible open intervals, constant objectives and unbounded objectives.

Verify shared-observation identity, linked choices across accounts/dates, mutually exclusive cells, incompatible marginal extrema, source-linked contradiction cores, unresolved obligations, unsupported nonlinear expressions, zero-work budgets and deterministic interruption after a completed cell. Inject solver-unknown results at the backend boundary without relying on timing races.

Check finite joint weights, exact posterior 3/11 and 8/11, duplicate information rejection, zero-probability conditioning, unweighted-mean rejection and retained unresolved/default mass. Check grouping preservation and invalidation when rate, maturity, scenario or horizon requirements change.
Run python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_accounting_p03.py' -v for integration regression. Do not rerun its output-writing checker or rewrite accepted P03 evidence.

Run python3 -B scripts/check_accounting_p04.py --output-dir data/accounting-master/deliverables/P04 --execution-inventory <actual supervisor execution-entry inventory>. Require a successful exit, matching source/test hashes, complete observations and unchanged protected inputs. The placeholder must resolve to an existing supervisor record before execution.

steps: 1. Establish the execution contract before implementation. Add docs/design/spec/reconstruction-profile-v1.md and docs/design/fixtures/p04-reconstruction-cases-v1.json; create the required progress.md checkpoint. Record the question—whether declared inputs generate the correct joint family within finite scope—the independent enumeration/algebra comparators, mandatory pass criteria, failure/repair triggers and exclusions. Record each material default's provenance, justification, failure mode and early diagnostic. Skeptical audit: the legacy equations are reference evidence only; frontend agreement and solver success are insufficient; no stochastic ranking or performance claim is planned. Missing dependencies/protection evidence or changed protected inputs stop acceptance; failing cases trigger repair, not scope reduction.

2. Add scripts/reconstruction_v1.py with explicit versioned input/result records and bounded validation. Define registry templates containing posting incidence and economic-state changes, opening states, slots, finite choices, contextual observations, uncertainty admissions, mappings, query requirements and budgets. Validate references, duplicate IDs, rational values, contexts and bounds before expansion. Add an adapter from validated P03 IR plus explicit template bindings; preserve its provenance and leave the original IR unchanged.

3. Construct constraints mechanically. Instantiate each declared slot once, give it an activation flag and nonnegative amount, and require inactive amounts to be zero. Share symbols by economic and observation IDs. Derive dated state roll-forwards and report expressions from template coefficients, then attach each accepted observation domain once with source/assumption IDs. Apply branch guards jointly across all accounts and dates. Retain unmatched obligations and exclusions; they must prevent an unjustified ExactWithinScope result.

4. Add scripts/rational_solver_v1.py for exact linear formulas. Classify expressions before solving; enumerate finite choices and bounded integer assignments lazily while retaining continuous families symbolically. Implement fixed/floating amount parameterisation F+V=D and document its equivalence conditions; preserve admissible constant fraction restrictions only when sign conditions justify cross-multiplication. Symbolic products, unsupported functions and unbounded integer domains produce Unknown with the original expression and reason, never Infeasible.

5. Implement numerical semantics and bounds. Preserve explicit interval endpoints and disclosed rounding conventions. Support exact half-even posting quantisation; symbolic quantisation requires bounded minor-unit cases rather than a continuous relaxation. Check feasibility on original constraints first. For each feasible continuous linear cell, optimise its closed relaxation for infimum/supremum, then test endpoint attainment against the original strict constraints. Record exact rational bounds, witness/proof queries, scope and rounding stage. Handle unboundedness separately; any unknown proof or attainment check leaves the affected bound uncertified. Recheck source-labelled unsatisfiable cores without claiming minimality.

6. Preserve search state and joint queries. Count total, feasible, infeasible and unresolved cells with a documented completed-cell convention. Enforce limits on slots, expanded formula size, integer assignments, cells, solver resources and elapsed time; retain unvisited regions compactly. A feasible witness may coexist with PartialSearch; Infeasible requires every cell proved infeasible. Bounds from completed cells alone are explored bounds when unresolved cells remain. Return joint formulas and branch IDs, and test proposed output tuples against the shared constraints instead of combining marginal extrema.

7. Implement bounded uncertainty and resolution operations. Validate the six uncertainty kinds against their required provenance/admission fields; unsupported treatments remain unsupported. Keep factual evidence, hypothetical stress and likelihood updates distinct. Optional finite probabilities require explicitly disjoint economic hypotheses and a declared joint measure; preserve unresolved/default mass and reject unconditional summaries with missing outcomes. Permit only documented additive grouping with retained contract memory and matching rate/reset/maturity/hedge keys. Bind grouping validity to the query, scenario and horizon; changed requirements force revalidation. Approximate or unproved grouping stays unsupported.

8. Write tests/test_accounting_p04.py and the independent oracles. Use small synthetic known histories plus selected immutable Northstar and borrowings inputs. Construct observations by independent replay, then reconstruct from those observations without supplying hidden histories or expected constraints to production code. Compare entire finite feasible sets, exact continuous endpoint cases, contextual rejection and resource outcomes. Include P03-to-P04 integration and every check listed above. Keep the fixture catalog tied to executed assertions, not authored success flags.

9. Add scripts/check_accounting_p04.py and generate the two required deliverables. conformance.json must contain actual inputs/hashes, generated constraints, witnesses/cores, endpoint checks, cell coverage, oracle comparisons, test outcomes and acceptance boundaries. result.md must include the decision table, strongest alternative explanation and exact unfinished work. Record command, interpreter/package versions, CPU-only execution, deterministic seed status, wall time, approved-plan reference, execution inventory and every changed file. Use durable supervisor provenance and before/after hashes; do not import legacy scripts with output-writing side effects. Update progress.md after meaningful edits and finish verification before the reserved response interval.
summary: PLAN: implement a separate, versioned reconstruction layer that builds joint constraints from declared templates and evidence, solves bounded exact rational/finite-choice cases, and preserves uncertainty, strict endpoints and incomplete search. Independent enumeration and algebra are the acceptance oracles; existing P03 and frozen reference evidence remain unchanged.
